segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, second page's minetn entry) to Mine Town. The seed and character differ from the existing Mine Town loader cases; after arrival, rooms.c check_special_room() calls hack.c in_town() at the hero's location before recording the Mine Town achievement. The fresh differential exercises makemon.c set_mimic_sym() for a mimic in a conceptual subroom shop and pins the C rn2(10) shop-selection draw.
